tasks.title: Diagnose, repair and verify the suite
tasks.description: The end-to-end suite fails: the runner crashes on startup with a hosted-service dependency-injection error (exit code -532462766) before any transaction runs. The fault is a single trap (s13#8) in Runner/Runner.csproj: the runner yaml uses 'Generator: FromFileSystem' but Runner.csproj does not reference the QaaS.Common.Generators package that provides that generator, so DI cannot construct it. Reproduce the failure, apply the MINIMAL fix to Runner/Runner.csproj (add a PackageReference to QaaS.Common.Generators with Version='*' - change nothing else; do NOT edit the yaml or rename anything), write DIAGNOSIS.md citing s13#8 explicitly, and run the e2e verify gate.
rubric: Diagnosis is complete and references the exact trap

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','test.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory '..\Mocker' -PassThru; $ok = $false; foreach ($i in 1..40) { try { (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', 8122)).Close(); $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep 2 } }; if (-not $ok) { Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force; exit 9 }; dotnet run -c Release -- run test.qaas.yaml; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code

acceptanceCriteria: E2E runs successfully green (runner no longer crashes at startup)
failureModes: Editing the yaml instead of the csproj

goalOneSentence: Diagnose and fix missing-package crash caused by trap s13#8.
portContract: This sprint's mocker MUST listen on HTTP port 8122. Every runner Transaction MUST target http://127.0.0.1:8122. Do NOT use the 8080 default from Fact Base examples - use 8122 exactly.
